GlobalPolicy.module-level-focus: Fast unit checks: DTO validation, MongoDB query logic, saga state transitions
GlobalPolicy.wave-level-focus: Bottom-up: MongoDB → Reader queries → Writer command publish → Worker saga processing
GlobalPolicy.phase-level-focus: Full regression: all unit + integration + compensation + idempotency replay + read-write consistency
GlobalPolicy.autonomy-gate: Each shared module needs commands, scenarios, evidence, and wave/phase follow-up
GlobalPolicy.redaction: Never log account numbers, full amounts, SWIFT codes, or PII

VF-001.NAME: CommandPathHappy
VF-001.scenario: Payment command flows: Writer → MQ → Worker saga → settled
VF-001.expected-outcome: PaymentSettled event, saga state=Settled, payment document persisted

VF-002.NAME: QueryPathFast
VF-002.scenario: Payment query via Reader API from MongoDB cache
VF-002.expected-outcome: Response latency ≤100ms p95, correct payment document returned

VF-003.NAME: SagaCompensation
VF-003.expected-outcome: Compensation runs, saga state=Failed, no double-settlement

VF-004.NAME: SagaDLQOnFailure
VF-004.scenario: Payment saga fails at any step (validation, enrichment, settlement)
VF-004.expected-outcome: Saga fails gracefully, PaymentFailed event published to DLQ with full context (original request, failed step, error), NO automatic compensation

VF-005.NAME: SagaIdempotency
VF-005.scenario: Duplicate PaymentCommand with same IdempotencyKey — saga skips re-execution
VF-005.expected-outcome: If saga already completed, Handle returns PaymentSettled without re-executing steps. Idempotency enforced by saga state lookup.

VF-006.NAME: AccountStatementQuery
VF-006.scenario: Account holder queries transaction history via Reader API
VF-006.expected-outcome: Paged list of payments returned, sorted by date descending, where account is sender or receiver. Latency ≤ 200ms p95.

module-checks.check-2: Reader GET endpoints respond with payment documents or 404

V-M-READER.wave-follow-up: Integration: Reader → MongoDB queries correct documents

module-checks.check-2: Writer POST endpoint validates, publishes to MQ, returns 202

scenarios.scenario-1: Valid payment command → 202 Accepted + correlationId → message published

V-M-WRITER.wave-follow-up: Integration: Writer → Dapr pub/sub (in-memory stub) → Worker receives command
V-M-WRITER.phase-follow-up: Load test: 1000 POST/s, verify partition key routing

module-checks.check-2: All DTOs, commands, events, models serialize/deserialize correctly
module-checks.check-3: All validators pass for valid and invalid inputs

scenarios.scenario-2: Invalid JSON rejected with validation errors

V-M-SHARED.wave-follow-up: DTOs used consistently across Reader, Writer, Worker, Persistence

module-checks.check-2: PaySaga happy path: all steps complete, saga state=Settled

scenarios.scenario-1: Valid command → saga completes, PaymentSettled event
scenarios.scenario-3: Replayed after partial progress → skips completed, finishes pending

V-M-WORKER.wave-follow-up: Integration: real MongoDB + Testcontainers, full saga flow
V-M-WORKER.phase-follow-up: Chaos test: kill Worker pod, verify saga resumes

module-checks.check-2: Transactional writes: payment + saga state atomically

Gate-Phase-1.goal: Contracts, MongoDB layer, unit tests pass

Gate-Phase-2.goal: Reader and Writer working end-to-end to MQ

Gate-Phase-3.goal: Worker saga, DLQ failure handling, idempotency pass all tests

Gate-Phase-4.goal: K8s deployed, 1000 msg/s write path + 1000 queries/s read path, zero loss, DLQ processing
